computer_connect_recovery_copy_fallback: Copy failed. Select and copy the instructions.
computer_connect_recovery_instructions:
Restore OpenTag’s existing connection on {computerName} (Computer ID: {computerId}).

Use the existing installation and configuration. Run `opentag doctor --json` and `opentag daemon status --json`, inspect recent logs as needed, and fix the diagnosed connection issue. Use `opentag daemon start` only if the installed service is stopped.

Preserve the Computer and Agent bindings. If new credentials are required, ask me for this Computer’s “Repair connection” command.

Verify actual reconnection; a running service alone is not proof. If you cannot verify it, ask me to check the Online status in OpenTag. Briefly report the result.
computer_connect_recovery_intro: Paste this into your coding assistant on {computerName}.
computer_connect_recovery_repair_scope: Get a new connection code. Your Agents stay on this computer.
computer_connect_recovery_wake: Turn on or wake this computer and check its internet connection.

computer_connect_registered_help: If it stays offline, check for errors where you ran the command.
